convert_eqv2_to_hydra: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script to convert an Equiformer v2 checkpoint and yaml config to Hydra format
convert_checkpoint_and_config: run the script with eqv2 checkpoint and yaml paths to output a Hydra-compatible checkpoint and config
run_eqv2_conversion_cli: run the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 CLI module with four required arguments for input and output paths
review_eqv2_to_hydra_script: review the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script that wraps convert_checkpoint_and_config_to_hydra via argparse
summarize_eqv2_conversion: summarize the eqv2_to_hydra_eqv2 script that converts Equiformer v2 checkpoints and configs to Hydra format
